nameOfQualification: Basic Health and Wellness Skills (Secondary school)
description: To create awareness among school students about safety measures, healthy living, health promotion, basic first aid tips and sensitization on clean, healthy and safe environment. This would habituate them to apply fundamental concepts of healthy body, safety measures, disaster preparedness, CPR, First Aid, Healthy Lifestyle and Safe environment practices into their daily lifestyle and practice.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Apply Safety measures, disaster preparedness, CPR, First Aid, Healthy Lifestyle and Safe environment practices in day-to-day life

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.EDUCATIONCOMPLETED: pursuing continuous schooling in regular school from 9th to 10th Grade
